en: The Analysis of the Bhikkhunī Rules,
2.3 Section on Failures (Vipattivāra) For a lustful bhikkhunī who consents to physical contact with a lustful person, how many of the four failures do her offenses belong to?
For a lustful bhikkhunī who consents to physical contact with a lustful person, her offenses belong to two of the four failures.
There may be failure in virtue; there may be failure in conduct … [and so on] … For one who asks for curd and eats it, how many of the four failures do the offenses belong to?
For one who asks for curd and eats it, the offenses belong to one of the four failures—namely, failure in conduct.
The third section on failure is finished.
